dedupe_keys.name: scenario level data and reproducible screening calculations for dc ac sizing of grid connected photovoltaic systems in baghdad

description: Scenario-level data and reproducible screening calculations for DC:AC sizing of grid-connected photovoltaic systems in Baghdad is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors Atour Hamid, Hussein Fawzi Hussein (Scientific Research Commission). This dataset supports the manuscript “Performance and Cost Trade-Offs in DC:AC Sizing of Grid-Connected Photovoltaic Systems at Two AC Scales in Hot-Arid Baghdad.” It contains nine annual PVsyst scenario summaries for fixed 10 kWac and 1 MWac grid-connected photovoltaic systems in Baghdad. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2026. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
